subject: Banking
title: The Revolving Door
description: A quick win: understand The Revolving Door.

hook.text: Goldman Sachs alumni have served as US Treasury Secretary, World Bank president, and heads of central banks globally.

buildup.text: The revolving door means bankers move into government, write regulations, then return to banking.

discovery.text: Henry Paulson went from Goldman CEO to Treasury Secretary.

twist.text: Defenders say banking expertise is needed in government. Critics say it ensures regulation always favors Wall Street.

climax.text: The revolving door blurs regulator and regulated. When the same people write and follow the rules.

punchline.text: Goldman to Treasury and back again. The door keeps revolving.

quiz.question: What is the 'revolving door' in banking?
options: Bankers moving between Wall Street and government regulatory positions
